Status: Wave 275 accepted (6.3): resource-backed formatters and the Class431 remainder

Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods, selected by two new evidence helpers. resource-rows.py found the rows that format Knx.Ets.Hawk.Properties.Resources values, whose resource names name them: FormatSecurityFailureFlags and FormatSecurityFailures (SecurityFailures_Access/Crytographic/Seq/Other), FormatLcConfig (LCConfig_*), FormatLcGroupConfig (LCGrpConfig_*), FormatCouplerServiceControl (CouplServControl_*). The Class431 remainder: GetPriorityValues and GetObjectFlagValues are the two resource value lists it splits, and RemoveRunsWithSelector is the sibling of RemoveRunsOfByte/RemoveRunsOfBytes with a Func<uint,byte> selector. In Falcon, CreateConnectionFailedException builds the KnxIpUnicastConnectorException from the failure cause and connection type using the Exception_IpUnicast/IpTunneling connect-failed resources.
Method.themes: The resource-name pattern is the third reliable evidence source after literals and named siblings: an accessor that returns or formats a Resources property is named by that property. Negative result recorded for the native bridge: Class23's 68 free rows carry no literals, and their semantics live in the vendor dongle library, so they cannot be named from the managed metadata (field-users.py shows only free readers, and the entry points are resolved at runtime) - they need the vendor API or runtime tracing.
